defaultValue: Every stat step and script level costs design points. A design's ordnance point cost and its production price both come from its design points. Changes apply to saved designs the next time you load a save or open the designer.

fieldName: Design points to OP conversion rate
fieldDescription: Percent of a design's design points that becomes its ordnance point cost. 10 means 100 design points make a 10 OP weapon. 1 means 100 design points make a 1 OP weapon.
What a copy costs in custom production, in percent of the normal price.
Most ordnance points a design may cost to mount. 0 means no limit. Designs over the limit cannot be saved until they are made cheaper.
